name: Kagemiya Wazuka
source:
Itaru's childhood friend, who's one year older than he is.
Though very beautiful, she's quiet to a fault and doesn't show any outward emotion.
Despite that, on the inside she's very impulsive, not to mention stubborn and dedicated to whatever she decides to do.

Itaru saved her life when she was a child, and she's loved him ever since.
